name: palantir
description: Watches the running app: logs, status, new errors, resource use, environment and why a frontend's components render, across local, Docker and Kubernetes

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: What to watch besides the project's compose services and its .claude/palantir file, separated by ; and each written label=runtime:ref@root. For example web=local:logs/web.log@web; api=docker:my-api@api; kafka=k8s:staging/statefulset/kafka. Runtimes: local (a log file), docker (a container), compose (a service), k8s ([context/]namespace/kind/name). The roots after @ are the source folders whose edits count against it, comma separated; without any, every edit does. A local one may end with #port, the port its process listens on, which is how what it consumes is measured: web=local:logs/web.log@web#3000.

pollSeconds.title: Seconds between reads
pollSeconds.description: How often the attachments are read once there are some. 0 reads them only when asked: on /palantir, on Refresh, before an edit and when Claude calls a tool.

browserPort.title: Browser debug port
browserPort.description: The port, on this machine's loopback, of the Chrome whose tabs are asked why a frontend's components rendered and how its page stands (Chrome started with --remote-debugging-port). 0 never asks a browser.
